name: @repo/aurora-curtain
description: An AuroraCurtain background component for SmoothUI.

useCases: Hero section with drifting northern-lights ribbons behind the headline
Ambient section background for landing pages and pricing panels
Auth or waitlist card sitting on a soft animated light curtain
compositionHints: Wrap hero copy or a card so it renders above the curtain
Pair with gravity-stars for a layered night-sky backdrop
